summary: SkyWater Technology filed an 8-K disclosing that it and acquirer IonQ received a Second Request from the FTC regarding their pending merger. The HSR waiting period will extend until 30 days after both parties substantially comply. The deal involves a two-step merger where SkyWater will become a wholly owned subsidiary of IonQ. Terms (price per share, premium, consideration) were not restated in this filing. Both parties expect to cooperate with the FTC and anticipate closing in Q2/Q3 2026. Watch for regulatory clearance milestones and any required divestitures or remedies.
